author: jochembrouwer
content:
Feedback here from Nethermind: https://gist.github.com/LukaszRozmej/9fc6b743bb82e363e16a0337bfc0bbc9 should be addressed in EIP-8360:

> EIP-8360 — TCREATE Opcode · C Contracts that live for one transaction are a genuine state-hygiene win, and a cleaner path off SELFDESTRUCT than deprecation alone. But the proposal declares a dependency on EIP-7610, which was declined on 2026-08-20, and it does not yet say how a transient account appears in a block access list or under last-written-block metadata. Those need answers before it can be assessed.

author: jochembrouwer
content: I think it should be swapped to EIP-684 so we fall back to that collission mechanism (EIP-7610 is the extended version of it but we rejected that version in Glamsterdam, so EIP-684 is the current spec for collisison checks)
